en: Sepia-toned industrial scene showing a large mining or factory complex with multi‑storey administrative buildings, a very tall smokestack on the left and a massive elevated water tower on the right. The foreground contains fenced yards, rails and construction materials; wooded hills rise in the background. The reverse side is printed and handwritten in Hungarian, mentioning the 'Gróf Széchenyi István' mine shaft at Pécsbányatelep and a 1927 consecration.
